dogecoin.text: Elon Musk and Mark Cuban's endorsement of #Dogecoin reflects its growing acceptance. Small businesses like Williamsburg Pizza and University Sports Grill are leveraging its fast, low-cost transactions while embracing its vibrant online community for marketing. #cryptocurrency

Bitcoin surged over 7% to $82,350 following Trump's announcement of a 90-day tariff pause, boosting market confidence. This rally uplifted Ethereum, Dogecoin, and Solana as well. However, experts caution that uncertainty lingers, with Bitcoin still down 12% year-to-date.
